configuration: A deterministic subdivision-4 icosphere (5,120 triangles) and 4,096 deterministic Fibonacci-direction inside/outside queries; run nearby_faces, closest_point, and signed_distance and grade the returned closest coordinates and distances.
observable: Closest surface coordinates, unsigned distances, and signed distances for each deterministic query index; the alternating radius fixes outside/inside sign semantics.
runtime_note: under 300 s; Docker calibration measured nominal/variant 9.904/10.417 s, and the approved repeat measured 13.895/13.511 s, under the declared 4 CPU / 6 GiB container limit; native one-CPU runs were 3.50/3.42 s.
default_vs_upstream: The official file uses a subdivision-4 sphere with 100 radial queries, compares accelerated and naive closest-point paths on 100 triangles and 126 queries, and separately exercises nearby_faces on 2,000 faces/2,000 points. This check combines the same production paths into a deterministic 5,120-triangle/4,096-query workload; triangle IDs remain ungraded because ties admit multiple correct faces.
variant: The outside radius changes from 2.0 to 2.000000000000001, exactly two binary64 nextafter steps toward positive infinity; all 2,048 outside queries remain away from the surface and their graded distances change.
altbuild: none: Trimesh is a pure-Python package at this pin and no legitimate compile/build axis is present; swapping NumPy/Rtree backends is not treated as an altbuild.

comparison.rule: Compare every closest-point coordinate, unsigned distance, and signed distance in deterministic query order using |candidate-reference| <= atol + rtol*|reference|; triangle IDs are excluded because edge/vertex ties admit multiple correct faces.

evidence.floor_how: No alternate-build floor is available. Docker nominal-versus-two-ULP variant calibration measured 1.3322676295501878e-15 maximum spread over 20,480 graded values on x86_64.

fault_probes.what: flip signed_distance.npy[0] for the first outside query from -1.0004500655382198 to +1.0004500655382198
fault_probes.container: Debian GNU/Linux 13 (trixie), Python 3.13.5, NumPy 2.2.4; network none; cpu.max 400000 100000; memory.max 6442450944
fault_probes.reason: signed_distance.npy: 1 of 4096 values exceed atol=1e-12 rtol=1e-12 (max |err| 2.001e+00)

warrant: The human-approved 1e-12 absolute/relative bound grades physical closest coordinates and distances while allowing small platform-level floating-point differences. Docker calibration used 0.000666 of the bound, while a containerized deliberate sign flip produced 2.0009001310764396 absolute error and was rejected at bound fraction 1.0002249821407559e12. Candidate bounds use tol.merge before point-to-triangle distance arithmetic; the reviewer approved the tolerance unchanged on 2026-09-17.
